expectedMetricRanges.notes: The minimum critical-path zone objective acquire turn must stay at or above 4.0 so objective pickup no longer collapses into a two-turn flatline.
The minimum critical-path zone visible hostile turn count must stay above the zero-combat floor.
The minimum critical-path zone enemy turn count must stay above the zero-combat floor.
All critical-path zones must satisfy the objective/combat pacing floors.

notes: Critical-path pacing is evaluated from longRunLab fullRoute zone traversal diagnostics and kept separate from terminal build identity so late-game reward tuning does not silently redefine pacing floors.
Thresholds are the minimum formalization of the PR requirement: no 2-turn objective acquisition and no 0-combat critical-path zone.
